# Code

## Goal

Handle a focused implementation request without forcing a large planning workflow.

## Procedure

Read the root instructions, affected contracts, actual files, and working-tree changes. Identify the intended behavior and smallest complete change. Implement it within the user's authorized scope, preserve unrelated work, and run appropriate checks. Update documentation when contracts or verified commands change.

For a broad or ambiguous request, prepare the necessary design and plan while continuing independent work. Do not infer authorization for later phases, deployment, or publication. If the task is documentation-only, edit documentation only.

## Output

A complete, reviewable change with validation results and limitations. Record substantial work in the current task logs.
